newsitem.title: CANADA: Imasco not selling CT Financial.
newsitem.headline: Imasco not selling CT Financial.

text.p: Imasco Ltd said on Friday that it is not in discussions with Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce to sell CT Financial Services and its wholly owned Canada Trust unit.
Imasco said in a statement requested by the Toronto Stock Exchange that it was not in talks with CIBC about such a sale.

"Contrary to media reports, there are no discussions underway concerning the sale of Imasco's investment in CT Financial Services," Imasco President and Chief Executive Officer Brian Levitt said in a statement.

The statement followed an imposed halt of CT Financial shares by the Toronto Stock Exchange and denies a report in the Financial Post newspaper today that said "top secret" talks were being conducted between Imasco and CIBC.
Imasco owns about 98 percent of the common shares of CT Financial Services, the parent of the Canada Trust group of companies.
Shares of Imasco were up 0.95 after the announcement at 42.60 on the Toronto exchange, while CIBC shares were up 1.05 at 38.70 a share.
